body.cap: EntWick has won the CES 2025 Innovation Award for its personal arthritis treatment electroceutical, ArthronPulse. │Photo provided by EntWick

body.x: EntWick Inc. (CEO Jeong Jaejoon) announced its participation in CES 2025 in Las Vegas, USA, from January 7 to 10, 2025. The company will exhibit at the K-Startup Pavilion.

EntWick specializes in noninvasive electroceutical treatments. It develops and manufactures medical devices using advanced noninvasive technologies. As a research-focused venture, EntWick integrates years of product development experience and diverse engineering technologies to innovate medical and therapeutic solutions.

Non-invasive therapies are emerging as a cornerstone of future healthcare, offering safe and effective treatments without the chemical side effects of traditional pharmaceuticals. Dubbed the "third wave of new drugs," this field is gaining attention for its potential to treat various chronic conditions. With a focus on the aging population, EntWick is advancing personal electroceuticals for chronic diseases, addressing conditions such as arthritis, hair loss, and deep vein thrombosis (DVT).

ArthronPulse, the world's first miniaturized PEMF medical device, is a flagship product with patents pending in South Korea, the United States, Canada, Europe, Japan, and China. The device was recognized with the CES 2025 Innovation Award and previously garnered interest from global buyers at IFA NEXT and MEDICA 2024 in Germany. At CES 2025, EntWick will showcase ArthronPulse to North American buyers at the Eureka Park exhibition.

ArthronPulse is a personal electroceutical device for arthritis treatment scheduled to launch next year. It employs noninvasive technologies, including Pulsed Electromagnetic Field (PEMF) and Low-Level Laser (LLL) therapy. The wellness version also integrates heat massage and Electrical Muscle Stimulation (EMS) therapy, providing a comprehensive solution for arthritis pain relief.

The device allows users to combine or use therapies individually, maximizing treatment effectiveness. Its built-in battery ensures portability, catering to users with limited mobility due to pain. EntWick also plans to scale production and export wellness products to Europe, the Middle East, and the Americas. The company will actively promote its next product, HairoPulse, a hair loss treatment device, complete certification, and launch the medical device version of ArthronPulse.

AVING News, which has covered CES for 19 consecutive years, continues to bridge the gap for Korean SMEs and startups looking to expand globally. To promote Korean startups worldwide, AVING will host its Broadcasting Zone at the Venetian Expo, featuring the CES Media Day Startup Conference and global media interviews. AVING’s international media partners will cover these programs.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host review conferences with participating companies in Korea, offering a platform for increased visibility and improved corporate image.
